text:
maria: Heads-up — we need a coordinated plan for new runtime routing + quota metrics to power the console dashboard and rollout UX. Can eng-platform, runtime, and infra agree on exporters/aggregation/retention?
casey: Which specific metrics are we proposing?
jordan: Minimal set: runtime.request_total (by route), runtime.routed_variant_total, runtime.quota_exceeded_total, runtime.kv_cache_hit_total, runtime.kv_cache_miss_total, runtime.batch_size_histogram. Labels: route, model, region, tier.
evam: (typo) evan: Cost and retention matter — longer retention for request_total is expensive. We should aggregate to 1h for >30d.
harper: For console widgets we need per-route 1m and 1h rollups, plus percentiles for latency and batch-size distribution. Also want a small sample of raw traces for recent 7d.
casey: Agree on labels. Also need a stable metric name scheme so rollout UX can query model pinned vs fallback variants: add label 'variant_type' (pinned|fallback).
sre-bot: exporter-check: runtime-exporter v0.9.2 deployed in prod clusters 3/5. Missing kv cache counters in v0.9.2.
maria: Pushed a quick snippet for the runtime team to implement (prometheus style):
```
# prometheus scrape target example
- job_name: runtime-metrics
  static_configs:
  - targets: ["runtime-collector:9100"]
    labels:
      env: prod
```
And counters: `runtime.request_total{route,model,region,tier,variant_type}` etc.
jordan: For aggregation: I'll own a daily job that down-samples 1m -> 1h and writes to metrics-aggregates (parquet). Plan: backfill 90d of 1h aggregates, keep 30d of 1m, 365d of 1h. ETA: start backfill next Tuesday, ~48h run.
ev an: evan: 365d 1h aggregates cost estimate ~ $850/mo across clusters — need finance signoff if higher. Can we sample heavy routes?
casey: Proposal: heavy routes (top 5% qps) sample to 10% for raw 1m retention, but keep full 1h aggregates. That saves storage and preserves dashboard fidelity.
harper: For dashboard UX I'll mock up two tiles: "Routing breakdown (1m/1h)", "Quota breaches (24h)". Also want ability to filter by model and variant_type. I'll drop mock by EOD Monday.
maria: Action list: (1) runtime: add counters + labels (jordan to review PR) (2) eng-platform: implement agg job + backfill (jordan) (3) infra: deploy exporter v0.9.3 to remaining clusters (casey) (4) finance: quick cost check on sampling plan (evan) (5) ux: mock tiles (harper).
casey: I'll schedule export rollout 0.9.3 canary tomorrow, full rollout Wed if green.
jordan: Starting backfill plan doc now, will post link when ready.
ev an: evan: finance ok with provisional $900/mo if we keep sample plan. Will confirm after final numbers.
harper: Mock posted: https://mockups/internal/1942109876-routing-metrics.png — feedback welcome.
maria: Thanks all — tagging @eng-platform for visibility. Will sync Friday 10am if no blockers. :thumbsup:
